title: siphocampylus manettiiflorus var. libanensis
intro: Siphocampylus manettiiflorus var. libanensis, commonly known as the Siphocampylus libanensis, is a species of flowering plant in the family Campanulaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions.
